descFull: Win顺：免费开源的 Windows 快速搜索启动器。双击 Ctrl，拼音秒搜文件、全文搜索 Word/Excel/PDF、剪贴板历史（代替 Win+V）、对话框搜索、任务栏搜索、插件、AI 助手 MCP。Free Windows search launcher: pinyin file search, full-text search, clipboard history, MCP server. Everything/Listary alternative.
